verdict.rationale: The SDK is a library you run in your own process via the Runner class. It is documented as provider-agnostic, supporting 100+ non-OpenAI LLMs and mixing providers per agent, and its default export to OpenAI's tracing dashboard can be switched off with OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING. A community report also shows it running under Temporal for durable execution on your own infrastructure. missing for 10: explicit documentation of fully self-hosted or local model endpoints, a self-hosted alternative to the OpenAI-only managed tools (web search, file search, code interpreter, hosted MCP), and independent hands-on confirmation of an air-gapped, vendor-free deployment.
